title: 101: Ambre – Sofia Larsson & César Pinto Castillo
description:
On the podcast: Sofia Larsson and César Pinto Castillo share how they built their company Ambi Studi and their flagship app Ambre, a recipe book and meal planner that lets you save recipes from any site, photo, or app and syncs privately across your Apple devices. 

They talk about César's college thesis turning into real production software for Volvo, Sofia's pivot from textile engineering into iOS development during a career burnout, a $150 Mac that couldn't even compile his first app, a "welcome call" from Apple Entrepreneur Camp that turned out to be a two-hour technical interview, and why design is becoming the real differentiator now that building software is easy.
